response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist software engineer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile systems, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantial recent hands-on C++ development on Windows (only ~6 months of C/C++ work in 2014-2015), no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle expertise, and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain experience despite a stint at a fintech (RIDE Capital) that used JS/TypeScript/GraphQL rather than C++.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains and languages
Some exposure to financial services industry via RIDE Capital
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (brief stint in 2014-2015), not the required 5-10 years
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle database expertise
No fixed income, derivatives, or direct capital markets technical work found in resume

key_factors.factor: No fixed income or capital markets domain expertise
